intro: Fandral's Message is a missive penned by Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus. It is entrusted to an adventurer to carry across the sea to the Ancient of Lore, Onu, in Darkshore.

p: Written by Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in the Cenarion Enclave, this sealed dispatch serves as direct correspondence between the acting leader of the night elven druids and Onu, the venerable Ancient of Lore dwelling within the Grove of the Ancients. After receiving reports regarding the state of Teldrassil's Oracle Glade, Staghelm wastes no time pressing couriers into service to send word south of Auberdine. The delivery requires travelers to journey across the waters to Darkshore, bridging the heart of the new World Tree with the older, shadowed mainland.
